name: Puppeteer

passives.name: Pull Their Strings
passives.effects: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions apply a Puppeteer stack for 15 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to render the target berserk for 2 seconds, causing them to gain 50% as (+150% of your heal and shield power) bonus attack speed and 40% bonus movement speed (25 second cooldown). If only one champion is alive on the enemy team, instead fear the target for the same duration.
Granting yourself or an ally a heal, shield, or ability-sourced buff reduces the cooldown of Pull Their Strings by 5 seconds, once per cast.

description:

Pull Their Strings (0s)
Attacking a champion adds a stack for 15 seconds. At 4 stacks, Berserk them for 2 seconds. You grant Berserk enemies an additional  Attack Speed and 40% Move Speed.

Healing, Shielding, or buffing yourself or an ally with an Ability reduces the Cooldown by 5 seconds.

If only one enemy is alive, instead Fear them for the same duration.
